verdict.rationale: The firm has a stated early-stage financing practice: its startup page describes guiding clients 'early through growth stage financings', and it cites high deal volume. However, the only explicit mention of convertible instruments is framed as representing venture funds and other investors, not founders. The Clerky partnership covers formation and 83(b) workflows but nothing in the evidence ties it to SAFEs. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of SAFEs, company-side convertible note/SAFE work for pre-seed/seed rounds, published SAFE explainers or forms, independent corroboration.
